import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders for the invitation components. INVITATION_FORMAT = """

{title_of_event}

{event_details}

When: {scheduled_date}

{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generates a sanitized HTML string for an event invitation. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain newlines). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date for the event. extra_info : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string ready for safe rendering in a browser. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (title_of_event, event_details, scheduled_date, extra_info)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str") # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS escaped_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) escaped_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True) escaped_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) escaped_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True) # Render the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=escaped_title, event_details=escaped_details, scheduled_date=escaped_date, extra_info=escaped_extra ) return invitation_html.strip()
